title: Spoke Co-op: Fix It Together

characters.name: Volunteer Mechanic
characters.visual_lock: Adult volunteer in their 50s, grey beard, faded co-op t-shirt, grease on knuckles, reading glasses on a cord

characters.name: Newcomer
characters.visual_lock: Adult newcomer in their 20s, braided hair under a beanie, denim jacket with patches, first time holding a wrench

locations.name: Co-op workshop floor
locations.description: Converted garage, pegboard wall of labelled tools, three repair stands, bikes hanging from ceiling hooks, roll-up door half open

visual_rules.lighting_key: Overcast daylight through the roll-up door, fluorescent fill, gritty contrast
visual_rules.style_prompt: handheld documentary photograph, overcast daylight, gritty texture, honest workshop details, muted color with safety-yellow accents
visual_rules.negative_prompt: lens flare, neon, glossy advertising, cgi, 3d render, text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands

exclusions: No implying repairs are free if parts cost money
